description: Authored manifest of canonical ARGUS workflow metadata. setup.sh reads this file and upserts one document per workflow into .soc-workflow-registry. Every canonical workflow file (soc-*.yaml) under this directory MUST have exactly one entry here; setup.sh fails closed otherwise. model_tier documents the intended Opus/Sonnet/Haiku tier for cost optimization; the physical connector id in YAML stays 'opus' and operators choose the model by swapping the underlying Kibana connector config.

workflows.summary: Sweeps open detection-engine alerts; runs unified in-pipeline triage, tiered response, and soc_argus_case_lifecycle for investigation tiers.
Periodic architecture review that emits capability_gap recommendations for operator approval.
Governance-gated applier for autonomous mutation_intent recommendations: enforces ownership, budget, cooldown, kill-switch, loop detection, and snapshot-before-mutate.
Dispatches Caldera operations to emulate adversary TTPs against the lab fleet.
Polls Caldera for operation status and streams results into the evolution log.
Detection-engineering loop: proposes rule_patch / rule_creation recommendations backed by evidence.
Hourly sync of enabled Kibana detection rules into `.soc-detection-corpus` for ARGUS coverage (live_sync provenance, rule_id keyed by detection engine id).
Adjusts attack-profile difficulty based on observed detection/response performance.
Analyses coverage gaps across MITRE ATT&CK and emits capability_gap recommendations plus per-technique coverage_gap docs.
Meta-agent loop: observes SOC state and emits mutation_intent recommendations to evolve ARGUS-managed artifacts (registry owner=autosoc).
Proactive threat hunt across signal sources; emits hunt findings and candidate detections.
Applies operator-approved deterministic recommendations (rule patches, exceptions, etc.) to the detection engine.
Recovery workflow triggered on kill-switch or regression failure: restores snapshots and disables misbehaving artifacts.
Retroactively tags owner metadata on artifacts that were created before the registry existed.
Replays the regression dataset against any proposed rule change and blocks apply on failure.
Harvests verified case outcomes into the regression dataset for future gating.
Response-path containment playbook: host isolation, process kill, and user-notification fan-out.
Every 8h, composes an operator-facing narrative summary of autonomous SOC activity and writes it to .soc_shift_handover.
Hourly rollup of per-skill invocation counts, success rate, and estimated hours/cost saved into .soc-skill-metrics.

AutoDEX B9 — Self-adjusting skills loop. Every 1h reads the latest .soc-skill-metrics rollup per skill_id, classifies through the evaluateSkillHealth verdict matrix (Liquid mirror of the pure-logic spec in kbn-argus-tool-manifest/src/skill_health.ts; 21 unit tests). Emits per-skill rows into .soc-skill-recommendations with verdict (insufficient_data | healthy | review | reprompt | demote) + closed-set recommended_actions (log_only | open_review_case | reprompt_skill | demote_actor | freeze_skill). Doc id = skill_id (idempotent upsert). RFC: rfcs/B9-skill-self-adjust.md.

AutoDEX B10 — Incident TTPs → threat-intel reverse loop. Hourly + on-demand. Reads confirmed .soc-forensic-summary cases + .soc-outcomes.techniques_observed, aggregates per ATT&CK technique, applies threshold gating (min_observations=2, base_signal_strength=0.4 capped+saturating at 0.95, source_trust=0.85), and emits canonical .soc-intel-feed rows with kind: ttp_observed and full evidence.* audit-trail block (observation count, TP/FP split, distinct actors / campaigns / rule_ids / incident_ids, window). Pure-logic spec at lib/argus/intel/reverse_intel_extractor.ts (24 unit tests). RFC: rfcs/B10-incident-reverse-intel.md.
Polls Kibana Cases every 15m for closed cases and emits a single immutable forensic summary per case to .soc-forensic-summary.
Watchdog loop that trips the kill switch when budget, regression, or loop-detection thresholds are breached.

ARGUS M2.1 — Detection Eval Vertical. Poller that reads the latest rows from .soc-argus-eval-runs (populated by the @kbn/evals-suite-argus-detection Playwright suite) and feeds pass/fail + variant-coverage metrics into soc_regression_gate and the ARGUS Detection Eval Scorecard panel.

ARGUS R11 — Reasoning Eval Reconciler. Polls .soc-reasoning-eval-runs (written by @kbn/evals-suite-argus-reasoning), emits a fast-path quarantine hint on gate_decision=fail, writes a decision.kind=reasoning_eval governance span into .soc-reasoning-trace, and marks rows reconciled. Trust-tier transitions stay with soc_argus_trust_tier_assessor.

ARGUS M2.4 — Frontier Simulator. Runs on a 30m schedule only while the Mythos-class preset is armed. Picks one primitive + variant axis from the on-disk variant bank and emits a single labelled event into .soc-eval-corpus-<corpus_id> for the M2.1 Detection Eval Vertical to replay. Produces corpus rows, not executed attacks — Caldera remains L5 territory.

ARGUS Phase 1 — Manual-only arming switch for the Mythos-class adversary preset. Writes a signed arming record to the artifact registry and audit trail; the simulator and Caldera level-6 profile refuse to run unless this arm is active and within its window.

ARGUS M2.2 — Exploit-to-Detection reconciler. Polls .soc-cve-advisories for advisories synthesized by the CLI/tool, promotes them to status=detected, then reflects downstream @kbn/evals verdicts (auto_apply_ready/blocked_eval) back onto the advisory as eval_pass/eval_fail.

AutoDEX B1 — autonomous synthesis driver. Scheduled every 5m; reads .soc-kill-switch; selects pending CVE advisories from .soc-cve-advisories; runs Path A end-to-end per advisory by invoking the security.argusSynthesizeAdvisory workflow step (Pareto frontier + LLM-variant generation + validation + canonical mutation_intent write). Replaces the legacy TaskManager-driven synthesis_driver_task. Write-time B16 contract guards in the step refuse drifted documents.

ARGUS Phase 3 — Per-actor trust tier assessor. Computes tier (frontier/trusted/probationary/quarantined) per agent using 30-day eval pass rate, reasoning-trace quality, rejection + rollback counts; writes one record per actor into .soc-actor-trust-tiers and updates the actor policy fields consumed by the trust gate.

ARGUS Phase 3 — Non-invasive trust policy gate. For every recommendation in auto_apply_ready, looks up the producing actor's tier; if the tier's policy forbids auto-apply or the rec's risk/impact exceeds the tier's caps, flips the rec to pending_review with rejection_reason=trust_policy. R5: also enforces door_class=one_way → pending_review regardless of tier.

AutoDEX B5 — Non-invasive crown-jewel asset gate (12th gate, vision-doc 6.3). For every auto_apply_ready mutation_intent without a `crown_gate_decision`, calls the registered `security.argusEvaluateCrownJewelImpact` step (loads `.soc-crown-jewels`, Zod-validates, runs the deterministic helper). Demotes to pending_review with rejection_reason=crown_jewel_gate when any matched asset is gold/platinum/crown, or silver with gate_active=true. Idempotent via the `crown_gate_decision` field.

AutoDEX D2.5 — Benchmark rollback exerciser. Runs every 24h + manual; gated on `.soc-kill-switch[scope=benchmark_mode].enabled`. Picks the most-recently-applied ARGUS-owned rec, posts a rollback_mutation_intent, stamps the parent rec with `status: rolled_back`. Quiet-cluster fallback emits a synthetic rolled_back row so D2.5 can verify the wire format end-to-end. Disarmed by default; never fires in production unless an operator writes the arming doc.

AutoDEX B9 — Self-adjusting-skills CONSUMER. Every 30m reads `.soc-skill-recommendations` rows with verdict in {demote, reprompt} where applied!=true, upserts `.soc-skill-policy/{skill_id}` (enabled:false for demote / prompt_revision_required:true for reprompt), stamps the source rec as applied (dedup key), writes one autonomy-decisions row per applied verdict + reasoning trace. Closes the producer-consumer loop opened by `soc_skill_self_adjust`. RFC: rfcs/B9-skill-self-adjust.md.

ARGUS governance gap (Severity-1) — HITL pending_review SLA watchdog. Every 30m scans `.soc-recommendations` for `status: pending_review` rows in three age bands (24h ping, 72h escalation, 168h SLA-expired). Stamps `sla_pinged_at` / `sla_escalated_at` / `sla_expired_at` (idempotent dedup keys), writes one `.soc-autonomy-decisions` row per band breach with `gate: hitl_sla`. Never changes status; lifecycle manager owns closure at 7d.

ARGUS governance gap (Severity-3) — trust-tier hysteresis. Runs every 1h after the assessor; appends one row per actor per tick to `.soc-actor-tier-history`, computes the worst tier across the last `window_size` (default 3) evaluations, and BLOCKS upgrades that haven't been sustained for that many consecutive ticks. Downgrades pass through immediately (a degrading actor must isolate fast). Audit rows in `.soc-autonomy-decisions` with `gate: tier_hysteresis`.

AutoDEX governance gap (Severity-3) — operator-facing LLM cost telemetry. Every 1h reads the rolling-24h count of `synthesis.advisory` rows + `halted_cost_budget` decision rows, snapshots driver-level call counts into `.soc-cost-ledger`. Pulse panel + dashboards graph the rolling-24h spend without re-running the count query. Doc id is per-driver per-hour for clean trend lines.

ARGUS Phase 3 (R8) — Shadow / dry-run executor. Replays every auto_apply_ready draft rule against historical telemetry and writes a verdict into .soc_rule_backtester-runs. Recs whose hit-rate exceeds the noise-cannon cap are downgraded to pending_review; passes are stamped shadow_gate=pass so the autonomous applier can pick them up.

ARGUS R14 — CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities live-feed orchestrator. Runs every 30m to surface (a) KEV freshness metrics, (b) CISA entries still waiting for the Exploit-to-Detection reconciler, and (c) KEV entries whose CISA due_date is within 72h but have no draft rule yet. The HTTPS fetch itself is done by the @kbn/argus-kev-ingest CLI; this workflow is the in-cluster funnel view.

ARGUS Phase 3 (R10) — Reasoning-confidence dropout watchdog. Every 5m compares an actor's 15m mean argus.decision.confidence against the 24h baseline; if the short-window mean drops below the absolute floor or falls more than dropout_threshold vs. baseline, the actor is frozen (tier=quarantined, watchdog_frozen=true). Complements the hourly trust-tier assessor with short-horizon safety.
Validates mutation_intent envelopes written into .soc-recommendations and reroutes malformed docs to .soc-dead-letter with structured error reasons.
Emits pipeline-run telemetry rows so dashboards can chart cadence, success, and failure counts across the workflow fleet.
Observes the effects of applied recommendations on downstream KPIs and writes observation rows to .soc-post-apply-observations.
Backtests rule recommendations against historic alert data before they are eligible for auto-apply.
Self-learning loop: mines outcome rows for signal quality + rule drift and emits follow-up recommendations.
ARGUS Demo Scenario 1 — Same-day CVE → Detection. Orchestrates the synthesize→index→reconcile→eval chain against a seeded advisory so the end-to-end detection vertical can be demoed in one click.

ARGUS Demo Scenario 2 — Polymorphic Variant Swarm. Orchestrates the frontier simulator → eval suite → trust gate chain against pre-seeded variants so the polymorphic resilience story can be demoed live.

ARGUS Phase 3 — Drift detection. Scans .soc-argus-eval-runs for rule eval-score drift (EMA baseline vs. current window) and .soc-actor-trust-tiers for actor trust-tier trajectory. Files mutation_intent recommendations to re-evaluate affected rules or re-run trust assessment; honours a 48h cooldown so a single drifting rule does not spam the recommender.

ARGUS Phase 3 — Playbook learning loop. Correlates .soc-outcomes, .soc-autonomy-decisions, and .soc-post-apply-observations per (technique, playbook_step) pair; when success or rollback rate crosses a threshold, files a mutation_intent to remap the pair to a safer candidate step drawn from soc-simulation/argus/technique-playbook-mapping.json. Gated to frontier-tier actor outcomes to stay adversary-proof.

ARGUS Phase 3 — Generic intel-feed adapter. Demo-grade upsert path into .soc-intel-feed. On first tick (or when manually forced) it loads soc-simulation/argus/intel-feed-seed.json, then emits an hourly heartbeat so the ARGUS console can show feed health. Placeholder for the Glasswing/TAXII adapter; replaces nothing, only fans intel rows into the store.

AutoDEX B4 — Detection-as-code (DaC) export spike. Every 1h scans applied ARGUS-authored mutation_intent rows that have not yet been exported and queues a DaC artifact per rule into `.soc-dac-export-queue` for an out-of-cluster sidecar agent to pick up and open PRs. Pure-logic core: `lib/argus/dac/rule_artifact.ts` (23 unit tests; round-trip identity proven). Keeps git credentials out of Kibana. RFC: rfcs/B4-dac-export.md.

AutoDEX B3 — production-grounded FP baseline roller. Every 24h aggregates per-rule alert counts from `.alerts-security.alerts-default` over the last 7 days and writes one row per rule into `.soc-rule-fp-baseline` (verdict=volume_only/cold_start, expected_alerts_per_hour grounded). Pure-logic spec at `lib/argus/governance/fp_baseline_estimator.ts` (22 unit tests) covers the full verdict matrix including the labelled / insufficient_labels paths a follow-up registered step will consume. RFC: rfcs/B3-fp-baseline.md.

AutoDEX B2 — production CTI source spike. Every 30m, fans out KEV advisories already fetched by `soc_kev_ingest` into `.soc-intel-feed` rows of `kind: exploit_availability` so the M2.3 exploit-probability mythos_signal contributor reads real CISA-curated production data instead of demo seeds. Idempotent (intel_id=kev-<cve>); zero new auth, no new HTTPS clients. RFC: rfcs/B2-production-cti.md.

ARGUS analytics-cluster CTI enrichment adapter. Daily ETL pipeline that queries ia-cti_enrichment index from the analytics SDE cluster, applies PII scrubbing (strips customer metadata, hashes agent.id, removes IPs), transforms CTI data into advisory documents, and upserts to .soc-cve-advisories with source=analytics_cluster provenance.

ARGUS Phase 3 — Mythos-signal aggregator. Every 30m discovers CVEs with activity in .soc-intel-feed (14d window), computes a trust-weighted, bounded [0,1] signal per CVE, and upserts one row per CVE into .soc-intel-mythos-signals. Complements the Shadow-AI-derived mythos_signal already produced by @kbn/argus-exploit-probability.
Polls open alerts not yet hypothesis-scanned; creates advisory docs to trigger synthesis when CVE coverage is absent; emits reasoning-trace and audit heartbeats.
Find-or-create investigation case, attach alert with rule context, tag tier/confidence, optional argus_mutation_id field, conditional assignee, audit trail.
Governance-gated Defend response actions (isolate, kill_process, scan) with kill-switch, trust tier, budget, and cooldown gates plus audit.
Discovers Fleet integrations and proposes enabling critical/high prebuilt rules missing from the ARGUS corpus; writes recommendations, coverage gaps, and governance trace.
Detection Engine coverage overview API mapped into ARGUS coverage-gap rows; diffs native snapshots and emits recommendations for newly uncovered techniques.

AutoDEX vision-doc 4.2 — once-per-hour ATT&CK coverage rollup. Calls the in-cluster ARGUS coverage route and writes one slim {total_techniques, covered_techniques, coverage_pct} row to `.soc-coverage-snapshots`. Powers the Pulse panel coverage-trend tile (oldest + latest top_hits over the window).
Native Detection Engine space health and per-rule execution results; writes focused .soc-argus-health docs (source=soc_argus_de_health) and audit rows.
Every 5m aggregates ARGUS subsystem signals into one .soc-argus-health document with overall green/yellow/red status.
Bridge from Elastic ML anomaly records to .soc-hunt-findings as ml_anomaly_hypothesis rows; complements alert-driven hypothesis coverage.
Parameterized runner for coverage-gap-triage, datasource-gap, high-fp-tuning, and actor-escalation playbooks via ES queries and optional mutation intents.
Monitors applied ARGUS rules for high alert volume; correlates outcomes, alerts, autonomy decisions, and reasoning trace.
Subscribes to workflows.failed; logs failures, retries allow-listed operational workflows once, otherwise dead-letter and audit alerts.

ARGUS Tier 2 — Redundancy scanner. Scans .soc-detection-corpus for techniques covered by many overlapping rules, then files consolidation mutation intents for ARGUS-authored rules so reviewers can retire dominated duplicates. Runs on a 24h schedule and on-demand.
Meta-workflow that checks heartbeat freshness for all ARGUS/SOC workflow sources. Aggregates audit-trail heartbeats and detects stale workflows.
Auto-closes stale recommendations in open or pending status for more than 7 days without update. Prevents recommendation queue from growing unbounded.
Closed-loop FP rate measurement. For recently applied recommendations, counts actual alert volume and writes post-deploy validation records.
Monitors canary-mode rules deployed by ARGUS. Graduates healthy rules and flags unhealthy ones for rollback based on 24h alert volume.
